articles.title_en: Protecting Dynamic Industrial Robot Cable Carriers
articles.summary_en: This article is brought to you by Tsubaki KabelSchlepp . In modern automated manufacturing, six-axis articulated robots perform high-speed, multidirectional maneuvers under demanding operational cycles. However, as robot arms swivel, rotate, and extend, the electrical cables, fiber optics, and pneumatic hoses supplying them endure severe mechanical stress. Torsional twist, rapid acceleration, and repeated contact with machine structures often lead to premature conductor fatigue, insulation breakdown, and costly unplanned production halts. To overcome these multi-axis motion challenges, the Tsubaki KabelSchlepp Robotrax System provides a specialized three-dimensional cable carrier engineered specifically for complex robotic motion. Managing High Tensile Forces With Central Steel Technology

Asking someone to be your mentor is weird. Walking up to someone and asking, “Will you be my mentor?” has always seemed to me like the adult version of a kid walking up to another kid at a party and asking, “Will you be my friend?” What you’re really asking is: “Will you commit some amount of unpaid time to guiding my career for an indefinite period?” Framed that way, of course some people hesitate to say yes. articles.title_en: NASA’s Cargo-Moving Robotic Arm Named 300th IEEE Milestone
articles.summary_en: In the 1960s NASA began developing a system of reusable space shuttles to make its work more efficient and to reduce costs. The shuttles could launch like rockets, maneuver in Earth’s orbit, and land like airplanes. They also could carry large satellites to and from orbit. Like other types of transportation, machinery eventually breaks down, and parts need to be replaced or fixed. And the cargo being carried to and from Earth has to be moved to its final destination. To complete such tasks, Spar Aerospace (now part of MDA Space ) of Brampton, Ont., Canada, and the National Research Council in Ottawa developed a robotic arm, the Shuttle Remote Manipulator System . articles.title_en: AI Efficiency Could Cost Us the Next Generation of Experts
articles.summary_en: A little over a decade ago, I led the controls design for a first-of-its-kind full digital-control system for a U.S. nuclear plant. It was, on paper, a beautiful machine—engineered to run itself the way a modern airliner does, with operators watching over a system that rarely needed them. And we made a decision that, to an efficiency-minded observer, looked backward: We deliberately left manual steps inside sequences the system could execute on its own. We were solving a specific problem. An operator who only ever supervises automation slowly stops being an operator. The hands go cold. The mental model of what the plant is actually doing gets fuzzy. articles.summary_en: Across IEEE, our strength lies not only in the excellence of our individual communities but also in our ability to bring them together around shared problems that demand interdisciplinary solutions. Our mission as a public charity—to advance technology for the benefit of humanity—is becoming an increasingly powerful differentiator. It is more than a statement of principle; it is a strategic advantage. When engineers and technologists serve with purpose and lead with heart, they strengthen the future of our profession and demonstrate why IEEE is uniquely positioned to lead at the intersection of technology and societal impact. articles.title_en: This new reveal suggests MacBook Ultra might cost more than we think
articles.summary_en: As soon as next month, Apple is expected to introduce its next MacBook Pro redesign. We’ll be seeing OLED, the first touchscreen on a Mac, a thinner chassis, Dynamic Island, and much more. This upgrade was rumored to be called MacBook Ultra , though it wasn’t necessarily clear where that’d leave the MacBook Pro brand. Now, it’s a lot more clear. more…
articles.title_th: การเปิดเผยใหม่นี้ชี้ให้เห็นว่า MacBook Ultra อาจมีราคาสูงกว่าที่เราคิด
articles.summary_th: ภายในเดือนหน้า Apple คาดว่าจะเปิดตัว MacBook Pro ดีไซน์ใหม่ครั้งต่อไป เราจะได้เห็น OLED หน้าจอสัมผัสตัวแรกบน Mac ตัวเครื่องที่บางกว่า Dynamic Island และอีกมากมาย มีข่าวลือว่าการอัปเกรดนี้เรียกว่า MacBook Ultra แม้ว่าจะไม่ชัดเจนว่าจะทำให้แบรนด์ MacBook Pro อยู่ที่ไหนก็ตาม ตอนนี้มันชัดเจนขึ้นมาก มากกว่า…

articles.title_en: iPadOS 27 still needs simpler multitasking, here’s what I’d like to see
articles.summary_en: Last year, Apple completely reinvented multitasking on the iPad, with the introduction of windowing in iPadOS 26. At first, this meant the removal of the simpler version of multitasking, Split View and Slide Over. Those features did eventually return , but at a cost – they required you to use the clunky new windowing system. I was hoping iPadOS 27 would improve this, but it didn’t. more…
articles.title_th: iPadOS 27 ยังคงต้องการการทำงานหลายอย่างพร้อมกันที่เรียบง่ายกว่านี้ นี่คือสิ่งที่ฉันต้องการเห็น
articles.summary_th: เมื่อปีที่แล้ว Apple คิดค้นการทำงานหลายอย่างพร้อมกันบน iPad ขึ้นมาใหม่ทั้งหมด ด้วยการเปิดตัวหน้าต่างใน iPadOS 26 ในตอนแรก นี่หมายถึงการนำเวอร์ชันที่ง่ายกว่าของการทำงานหลายอย่างพร้อมกัน, Split View และ Slide Over ออก ในที่สุดคุณสมบัติเหล่านั้นก็กลับมา แต่ต้องเสียค่าใช้จ่าย - พวกเขาต้องการให้คุณใช้ระบบหน้าต่างใหม่ที่ไม่น่าเชื่อ ฉันหวังว่า iPadOS 27 จะปรับปรุงสิ่งนี้ แต่ก็ไม่เป็นเช่นนั้น มากกว่า…

articles.summary_en: Somewhere, a guy in Pit Vipers is recording a Facebook video from the front seat of his pickup claiming that Chinese EVs aren’t just inferior to American V8 iron – they’re unsafe, too. Unfortunately for him, the latest EVs from GAC, Geely, and Leapmotor just aced the brutally demanding Euro NCAP safety tests. more…
